items.title: Eddie Miller and Pete Fountain Interview, 1970-01-09
items.q: That was a great influence on me, and a lot of kids

ctx.x: He had a tremendous talent, didn't he?

But, oh, fantastic. And his band used to play a place they call Across the Tracks on Manny's. Really, I don't remember the name. I just remember how I used to get there, either by bus or something, and they were so great. They let me sit in to let a kid, you know, when you say 15, 16 years old, sit on 14, I think I was between 14 and 16 years old. And another one was that helped, well, Tony Almerico really did a wonderful job with kids. But we don't have, you don't have that place, any places like that to where…
Tony Almerico had that music room down in Wall Street.
